trace.notes: Input normalized as URL https://zbmath.org/6447840. The zbMATH web page was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge for direct fetch, but the zbMATH REST API record was readable and identified DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-10683-0_8 and title Open Problems on the Cross-correlation of m-Sequences.

Resolved candidate DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-10683-0_8 to the Springer chapter page https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-10683-0_8. The page exposes only abstract, references, and purchase/login controls; it does not contain the open-problem statements needed for extraction.

Direct Springer chapter PDF URL https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/978-3-319-10683-0_8.pdf redirected through idp.springer.com authentication and returned the chapter landing page instead of a readable PDF. OpenAlex reported is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, oa_url=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. Crossref exposed metadata and a Springer TDM link only.

Bounded exact-work recovery rejected candidate pages: DBLP was metadata with closed access; Springer book/chapter pages were preview or metadata; exact-title search surfaced a 2024 review on arXiv/ResearchGate, which was rejected because it is not the same 2014 chapter/source.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with blocked_or_challenged resolver access. Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source without switching to a different work or extracting from metadata, abstracts, or snippets.
